resources.string: Notifications reach your Apple Watch through Apple\'s push service, so the watch must be online — via Wi-Fi, a hotspot (such as this phone\'s), or cellular. Without internet, notifications won\'t arrive.
The top row of the watch app shows the phone link, this phone\'s battery ring, and a cloud icon.
